name: Report to Kadrak
summary: At the Crossroads, Thork sends proven Horde fighters north to report to Kadrak. The orc holds a watch tower near the Ashenvale border and prepares recruits for the fighting ahead.

sections.title: The Road North
sections.body: The Crossroads faces quilboar, centaur, and local brigands, while the Horde looks north to Ashenvale's thick forests. Thork directs fighters who have proved themselves in the central Barrens to the northern border tower, where Kadrak is stationed.

sections.title: Frontier Strategy
sections.body: Kadrak oversees the southern approach to Ashenvale and organizes reinforcements for the Horde's foothold across the border. Splintertree Post and an outpost along the Zoram Strand help the Horde strengthen its presence in the timber-rich woodlands, where native night elves resist them fiercely.

faq.answer: Thork is an orc officer at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He helps organize local defense and directs promising fighters toward campaigns such as the push into Ashenvale.
Kadrak is at the northern watch tower in the Barrens, beside the main road into Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the Horde pushing into Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Horde is pushing into Ashenvale for the lumber and resources needed to build its new cities in Durotar and the Barrens. The timber is vital, but seeking it brings the Horde into direct conflict with the night elves.

faq.q: What outposts has the Horde established in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Horde has established Splintertree Post along Ashenvale's central road and another outpost farther west on the Zoram Strand.

faq.q: What comes after reporting to Kadrak?
faq.answer: After you report to Kadrak, he briefs you on the local military situation and sends you to gather reports from the Warsong outposts across Ashenvale.

faq.q: Can you receive this assignment from anywhere other than the Barrens?
faq.answer: Yes. Horde fighters operating from Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains receive a nearly identical summons to report to Kadrak.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you are moving from the defense of settled Barrens territories toward securing vital resources in the disputed forests to the north.
As an orc, you are entering a crucial proving ground. Ashenvale's timber can help fortify Orgrimmar and establish a lasting home on Kalimdor.
